吴姜不知道是巧合，还是背后的邪道找上门了，刚才的交易他没有贸然开口，等中年人刚一离开，他立刻上前，不顾李叔正在专心致志地欣赏画作，一把将画卷了起来，紧接着，就是一道黄符贴了上去。

“小姜？你这是干什么？”李文博被吴姜的举动吓了一跳，一脸疑惑地看着他。

吴姜脸色严肃，语气凝重地说道：“李叔，这画有问题，还记得上次那幅画吗？这幅画跟上次那幅一样！”

“什么？！”李文博听到这话，顿时大惊失色，浑身冒出一身冷汗，手里的茶杯差点摔在地上，“又……又来？”

这……这现在的古玩生意，这么难做了吗？

吴姜拍了拍李叔的肩膀，好生安慰了一番，李文博这才稍稍平复了心情。

打发走好奇心爆棚、追问不停的李月芽，吴姜抱着画卷回了墨香居。

他没有直接回家，不知道外面有没有人暗中盯着，直到古玩城要关店了，这才将画卷装在包里，回了自己家。

吴姜将画卷摊在客厅的桌子上，先观察了一下画卷，先仔细观察了片刻，画中的女鬼十分安分，没有丝毫异动，仿佛只是一幅普通的仕女图。

过了片刻，吴姜手上浮现一缕鬼气，直接向着画卷抓了过去。

“出来吧你！”

一道倩影应声从画中被拽了出来，落在地上。

这女鬼同样是古装打扮，容貌绝美，身着一袭红衣，眉眼间却满是凶厉之气，比起苏婉清，要凶戾的多，显然，这是一只已经害过人的厉鬼。

女鬼刚一出来，就张牙舞爪地朝着吴姜猛扑而去，眼中满是杀意。

吴姜眼神一冷，没有丝毫客气，手上凝聚出一抹玄冥幽光，一巴掌扇在了女鬼的脸上。

“啪”的一声脆响，女鬼发出一声惨叫，像个破布娃娃似的，转着圈被吴姜扇飞了出去。

女鬼摔在地上，魂体微微颤抖，看着吴姜的眼神里满是恐惧，想跑又不敢，哪还有刚才半分不可一世的模样。

Wu Jiang didn't know whether it was a coincidence or the evil behind it. He didn't speak rashly about the transaction just now. As soon as the middle-aged man left, he immediately stepped forward and rolled up the painting regardless of Uncle Li who was concentrating on admiring the painting. Then, a yellow talisman was pasted on it.

"Xiao Jiang? What are you doing?" Li Wenbo was startled by Wu Jiang's actions and looked at him with confusion.

Wu Jiang looked serious and said in a solemn tone: "Uncle Li, there is something wrong with this painting. Do you remember the last painting? This painting is the same as the last one!"

"What?!" When Li Wenbo heard this, he was shocked and broke out in cold sweat. The tea cup in his hand almost fell to the ground, "Again... again?"

Is this... is the antique business so difficult to do now?

Wu Jiang patted Uncle Li's shoulder and comforted him, and Li Wenbo calmed down a little.

After sending away Li Yueya, who was full of curiosity and kept asking questions, Wu Jiang returned to Moxiangju with the scroll in his arms.

He didn't go home directly. He didn't know if anyone was watching secretly outside. It wasn't until the antique city was about to close that he put the scroll in his bag and returned to his home.

Wu Jiang spread the scroll on the table in the living room and observed the scroll carefully for a moment. The female ghost in the painting was very calm and did not move at all, as if it was just an ordinary painting of a lady.

After a while, a ghostly aura appeared on Wu Jiang's hand, and he grabbed it directly towards the scroll.

"Come out you!"

In response, a beautiful figure was pulled out of the painting and fell to the ground.

This female ghost is also dressed in ancient costume. She has a beautiful appearance. She is dressed in red, but her eyebrows are full of fierceness. She is much more ferocious than Su Wanqing. Obviously, this is a powerful ghost that has harmed people before.

As soon as the female ghost came out, she bared her teeth and claws and rushed towards Wu Jiang, her eyes full of murderous intent.

Wu Jiang's eyes were cold, without any politeness, a mysterious light condensed on his hand, and he slapped the female ghost on the face.

There was a crisp sound of "pop", and the female ghost let out a scream, spinning around like a rag doll and being slapped by Wu Jiang and flew out.

The female ghost fell to the ground, her soul trembling slightly. Her eyes were full of fear when she looked at Wu Jiang. She wanted to run but didn't dare. She still looked half arrogant just now.
